'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict]]
***[[2025 Bukavu offensive]]
****[[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] and [[Rwandan Defence Force|Rwandan troops]] seize control of [[Kavumu Airport]] in [[South Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/dr-congo-m23-rebels-seize-second-airport/a-71613601 (DW)]
****M23 forces and [[Rwanda]]n troops enter the city of [[Bukavu]], according to local security and [[humanitarian]] officials. There are no reports of resistance as most [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese troops]] withdraw. [https://www.digitaljournal.com/world/m23-fighters-rwandan-troops-enter-dr-congos-bukavu-sources/article (Digital Journal)]
****[[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese president]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]] cancels his participation in an upcoming [[African Union]] summit to end the conflict due to the "situation on the ground". Tshisekedi accuses Rwanda of [[invasion|invading]] the country to seize its [[Kivu|mineral-rich regions]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20250214-m23-fighters-rwandan-troops-enter-dr-congo-s-bukavu-sources (RFI)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant drone strike]]
***A [[Drone warfare|drone strike]]s the [[Chernobyl New Safe Confinement|New Safe Confinement]] structure housing the site of the [[Chernobyl disaster]]. [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] states that a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|combat drone]] caused significant damage to the structure, but did not produce an increase in external [[Ionizing radiation|radiation levels]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/14/europe/russia-ukraine-drones-chernobyl-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Eleven [[Coal mining|coal miners]] are killed and five others are wounded when a [[improvised explosive device|bomb]] hits a truck in [[Harnai]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-roadside-bombing-coal-miners-killed-balochistan-35774061a62d27cf63d79292ec9e2afd (AP)]
